text:
```yaml
name: Comment Artifacts
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["test-build"]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  comment-artifacts:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download artifact
        id: download_artifact
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v11
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          workflow: test-build.yml
          workflow_search: latest
          workflow_conclusion: success
          commit: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          name: iso-image
          path: ./artifacts

      - name: Get PR number from commit
        id: get_pr
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/commits/${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}/pulls" \
            | jq -r '.[0].number')
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Comment PR with artifact link
        if: ${{ steps.get_pr.outputs.pr_number != '' && steps.get_pr.outputs.pr_number != 'null' }}
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            :tada: ISO artifact built successfully!
            
            Download the ISO image from: [grml-live-${{ github.sha }}.iso](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}/artifacts/0)
            
            This is an automated comment based on the successful build.
          pr-number: ${{ steps.get_pr.outputs.pr_number }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
